body:
Hello,

Any change you could create a very small reproducer? It does sounds like a bug we should address
I would be more interested in an example of this working. You cannot extend a class in a different package if it is package-private.
Which it isn't.. I'm extending a class that is public but extending a class that is package private and in the same package.
If we could have both a working and the non working Quarkus equivalent, that would be great
Ah okay I misread it, sorry.
Is it dev mode where you have the problem or when running the built uberjar?

When running the uberjar.
I'm currently a bit busy so no time to create a test-case.
My actual inheritance looks like this, if that helps:

org.yaml.snakeyaml.representer.BaseRepresenter (package private)
org.yaml.snakeyaml.representer.Representer (public)
org.mypackage.MyRepresenter (public, no context annotation)
org.mypackage.MyActualRepresenter (public, @Dependent)

Error occurs when trying to @Inject  org.mypackage.MyActualRepresenter

@Xnyle, thank you for those details. I was able to reproduce this based on what you provided.

So the constructor of the generated bean is adding this (package private) class `Hello` into it `Set` to keep track of the `types` exposed by this bean.

So this boils down to Arc iterating over a bean and then trying to find the "types" it exposes. I think it's all in https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/master/independent-projects/arc/processor/src/main/java/io/quarkus/arc/processor/Types.java#L256 where it iterates the super classes. We might need @mkouba's help/inputs here.
